system.description:
A garrote is a two- to three-foot length of cord strung between two small wooden handles or leather loops. Roden use it to throttle victims to death. To use this skill, the would-be-murderer must attack from stealth or surprise (or against a victim already in a Lock). Test Garrote versus Power or Agility (victim’s choice, but at double obstacle). If the attacker lands a 2D or greater Lock, the victim loses 1D Forte every exchange thereafter. If Forte reaches zero, the victim falls unconscious.

FoRKs: Brawling

Skill Type: Martial. Tools: Yes.

Root: Agility

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 538
